applicability_domain.method: OLS hat-matrix leverage (Hoaglin & Welsch 1978); Williams-plot / leverage-approach AD (Gramatica 2007 QSAR Comb. Sci. 26(5):694-701)

attack_axis: edge-of-envelope / applicability-domain extrapolation (leverage-ranked held-out split), orthogonal to the prior four attacks' axes (test-resample CI, train-refit CI, cluster-count FPR calibration, post-hoc arm-selection winners-curse), all of which only ever scored within-DoE-envelope held-out rows
claim_scope: Statistical-methodology audit only (applicability-domain / extrapolation robustness of a single already-surviving significance claim), restricted to the Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer scratch-hardness leak-free 58-observation benchmark, normalized feature domain [0,1]^4. Does not modify or delete any prior receipt; reports whether the module's surviving significance claim generalizes to a genuinely unseen region of feature space, which the prior four attacks never tested. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. n=58 leak-free observations from a single formulator and a single instrument; a single rank-based interior/edge split (not cross-validated over multiple edge definitions beyond the reported sensitivity check); Phase-1 would still require a cross-formulator dataset and independent wet-lab validation.
honest_interpretation: EDGE-OF-ENVELOPE / APPLICABILITY-DOMAIN EXTRAPOLATION ATTACK on guth_gold_directional_concordance_exceeds_chance_leak_free. All four prior attacks (test-resample CI, train-refit CI, cluster-count FPR calibration, winners-curse selection-stability) score the model only on held-out rows that remain inside the same DoE envelope as training. This attack instead identifies the 12/58 unique leak-free rows with the highest OLS hat-matrix leverage (top 20% by leverage, k=12, chosen a priori) as an extrapolation zone, refits Guth-Gold from scratch on the 46 interior rows only, and scores directional concordance exclusively on the 12 held-out edge rows (n_pairs=63 after excluding tied targets) -- a genuinely harder, previously untested regime that matches design-rule-score's actual use case of ranking NOVEL (out-of-envelope) candidates. DATA FACT: the classical Williams-plot threshold h*=3p/n=0.2586 admits ZERO of the 58 rows (max observed leverage 0.2041) -- this DoE is unusually leverage-uniform, so the split is rank-based (top-quintile) rather than threshold-based; this is reported, not concealed. POINT ESTIMATE on the extrapolation set: Guth-Gold C=0.8095 (vs constant-mean chance-equivalent B0 C=0.5000, linear-4-feature C=0.7302, fit-free Rule-1 C=0.6190); Guth-Gold remains the strongest arm out-of-envelope. UNCERTAINTY: (a) test-resample bootstrap (B=10000) 95% CI [0.6226, 0.9661]; (b) train-refit bootstrap (B=10000, propagating estimation uncertainty from the 5-parameter nonlinear fit on the interior data, 0/10000 fit failures) 95% CI [0.6349, 0.8571]. Both lower bounds exceeds 0.5 (chance): REFUTATION CRITERION criterion_a=False (CI_a lower<=0.5), criterion_b=False (CI_b lower<=0.5). VERDICT: claim SURVIVED this attack. SENSITIVITY (diagnostic, not part of the pre-registered criterion): point concordance stays clearly above chance across alternative edge fractions 15%/25%/30% (0.7714/0.7586/0.7769). POSITIVE CONTROL (planted defect = full target vector y permutation-shuffled once before interior/edge split and refit, identical pipeline otherwise): shuffled train-refit-bootstrap 95% CI [0.3864, 0.6061], lower bound does not exceed (control collapsed as required) 0.5 -- the identical machinery that reports Guth-Gold stable and significant out-of-envelope on real labels correctly reports chance-level performance on labels with the true relationship destroyed, so the real-data survival is not an artifact of a test that always passes.

positive_control.how_planted: y_shuf = y.copy(); np.random.default_rng(0).shuffle(y_shuf); identical interior/edge index split and train-refit-bootstrap pipeline re-run on y_shuf in place of y
positive_control.planted_defect: full 58-row target vector y permutation-shuffled once (np.random.default_rng(0).shuffle) before the interior/edge leverage split and Guth-Gold refit

refutation_criterion: guth_gold_directional_concordance_exceeds_chance_leak_free is REFUTED under this attack if EITHER the test-resample bootstrap 95% CI lower bound OR the train-refit bootstrap 95% CI lower bound is <= 0.5 (chance) on the held-out leverage-extrapolation set. Survives only if BOTH lower bounds exceed 0.5.
